name: unity
description: Unity inside Claude Code: compile gate after C# edits, editor console, EditMode/PlayMode tests, play/stop and Game view screenshots through a small editor bridge package, batchmode runs when no editor is open. Works with any Unity project on macOS and Windows.

compileGate.title: Compile gate
compileGate.description: After Claude edits a .cs/.asmdef/.asmref file, refresh Unity and append the compile errors to the edit's result.

compileWaitSeconds.title: Compile wait (s)
compileWaitSeconds.description: How long the compile gate waits for Unity to finish compiling before it gives up.

debounceMs.title: Compile debounce (ms)
debounceMs.description: Edits landing within this window share one refresh.

editorPath.title: Unity editor path
editorPath.description: Explicit Unity editor binary for batchmode runs. Empty: found through Unity Hub from ProjectVersion.txt.

commitGuard.title: Restore-before-commit guard
commitGuard.description: Refuse a Bash `git commit` while a file listed under restoreBeforeCommit in .claude/unity.json is modified; the refusal names the `git checkout` to run first.

metaGuard.title: .meta guard
metaGuard.description: Refuse a Bash mv/rm (git, cmd, PowerShell too) of an asset under Assets/ whose .meta is not part of the same command; the refusal shows the corrected command.

autoOpen.title: Panel beim Start öffnen
autoOpen.description: Open the Unity pane at session start in a Unity project (unless a ticket-branch panel ranks higher).
